lore_anchors.definition: In Chinese geomancy and political cosmology, the dragon vein is the underground energy channel that shapes a dynasty’s fate and legitimacy. Severing one can cause a kingdom to collapse, but the effect is usually local.
A central philosophical path in the Dao-Twisted World, opposed by the Zuowandao’s “Cultivate the False.” It suggests the protagonist is trying to force an illogical world into being real.
A generic xianxia term for a cultivator’s practice going wrong, leading to madness, injury, or death. The Dice’s implied threat is that Li Huowang’s “true cultivation” path is inherently unstable.
A hospital-grade straitjacket used for high-risk psychiatric patients, emphasizing the severity of Li Huowang’s diagnosis in the modern-world reality.

Li Huowang’s former attending physician in the hospital, now himself a patient. His presence implies that engaging with Li Huowang’s worldview can drive a normal person insane, hinting at a contagion of logic.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang react so violently to Yi Donglai’s questions?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the doctor is using Li Huowang’s own logic—that the Dao-Twisted World is real—to undermine his sense of control. The violent outburst is a reflexive defense against the terrifying possibility that his belief system might be a fragile delusion.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is Wang Wei, and why does his appearance shock Yi Donglai?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Wang Wei was Li Huowang’s previous attending physician. His current insanity implies that engaging with Li Huowang’s worldview can drive a normal person mad, proving that the “illness” might be contagious through rational discourse—a revelation that shatters Yi Donglai’s professional confidence.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Zhuge Yuan say severing Great Qi’s dragon vein is “good for Great Liang”?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Dragon veins are localized. The collapse of a rival dynasty’s geomantic foundation weakens them without harming the other. It’s a geopolitical win-by-proxy in the Dao-Twisted World’s brutal logic.
